businessRules.statement: Every link connects two distinct sites. siteAdid ≠ siteBdid. Capacity is symmetric unless explicitly asymmetric.
Per-sample inMbps and outMbps MUST be ≤ link capacityMbps × 1.05 (5% measurement tolerance). Excess is recorded with an alarm flag.
incident.severity from openNetwork.incidentSeverity DMN: dataLoss → SEV1; ≥10k+down → SEV1; ≥1k+down → SEV2; ≥100 → SEV3; ≥1 → SEV4; else SEV5. SEV1/SEV2 → public notice.

change.riskLevel from openNetwork.changeRisk DMN: irreversible OR blastRadius ≥ regional → HIGH (CAB+VP); reversible AND blastRadius=site → MED (NOC manager); else LOW (peer review). HIGH → public CAB notice.
Incidents and change-requests are append-only. Status transitions create a new event referencing the original via supersedes.
businessRules.enforcedBy: no UPDATE on incidents/changes core fields
